fit_mhr_model_to_vertices: fit an MHR body model to target vertex positions using hierarchical PyMomentum optimization stages
get_fitting_results: get the optimized lbs model parameters, identity coefficients, and face expression coefficients after fitting
create_pymomentum_fitting_instance: create a PyMomentumModelFitting instance with an MHR model and optional vertex subsampling configuration
set_constant_parameters: set specific MHR model parameters to remain constant during the optimization fitting process
clustering_based_sampling: subsample 3D mesh vertices using K-means clustering to select representative points for efficient fitting
